Reshaped

 
 
 

 
 

 
 

Reshaped is a library with professionally crafted React & Figma components for building beautiful products or starting your own design system.

 

 Documentation

To get started, check out the Reshaped documentation.

 Packages

- reshaped - React design system with carefully designed components, hooks, utilities and design tokens.
 Implementation is synced with the Reshaped Figma library.
- @reshaped/headless - headless React components and utilities for building your own design system / product with custom styles
- @reshaped/utilities - framework-agnostic UI utilities built with vanilla TypeScript

 Coding agents

Reshaped provides agent skills with guidelines for building UI with Reshaped and for migrating from v3 to v4, together with the Reshaped MCP server.

In Claude Code, install them as a plugin:

 

For other agents supporting skills, like Codex or Cursor, copy the folders from plugins/reshaped/skills to the skills folder of your agent. They're also included in the reshaped npm package at node modules/reshaped/skills .

 Contributing

Read our contribution guide to learn about our principles, development process and testing.
